title: Analytics Lead, Health Data
description_html:
About the role

The province's health analytics unit reports on wait times and service use.

What you'll do

  • Lead a team of four analysts; mentoring is a large part of the job
  • Set standards for data visualization across the unit
  • Build forecasting models for service demand
  • Work with program directors; stakeholder management every week

What you bring

  • Statistical modelling
  • SQL and Python
  • Technical writing for public reports

Nice to have

  • Power BI

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $92,000–$108,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
